findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done.
Case: normal use - a jobs response example contains `label: '1) Select client'` before `url: '/api/v1/clients'` in a multiline `example: { ... }` object. The bracket counter treats the `)` inside the label string as the end of the object, so the URL is classified as a real use and Forge names jobs as a dependency. The prior round's multiline-example issue therefore remains open. The starter uses response example objects at `src/forge/templates/starter/libs/auth/server/src/members.controller.ts:42`.
